title: Feature-to-Toolpath Bridge — Geometry Pipeline Foundation
brief: Bridge the gap between part geometry/features and novel toolpath algorithms. Feature recognition → zone decomposition → algorithm selection → cutter-contact computation.

units.title: FeatureToZoneEngine — Geometric feature → machining zone mapper
units.description: Engine that takes feature descriptions (pocket dims, wall angles, freeform patches, hole patterns) and decomposes into machining zones with attributes: zone_type (flat/pocket/freeform/corner/wall/boss/undercut), area_mm2, depth_mm, curvature stats, draft angles, accessibility vectors. Outputs directly compatible with MTHZD/MACS zone inputs.
exit_conditions: Unit tests for each zone type

units.title: AlgorithmSelectorEngine — Auto-select best novel algorithm per zone
units.description: Decision engine that maps (zone_type, material, machine_capability, priority) → best novel algorithm from all 24. Uses scoring matrix: physics_match (Kienzle applicability), geometry_fit (pocket→TGAR, freeform→CFSF, deep→VCER, thin_wall→PTDC), material_fit (Ti→WHAP, hardened→PTAP), objective_fit (speed→DPLS, quality→HRAF). Returns ranked list with confidence scores.

units.title: CutterContactEngine — Analytical cutter-contact point computation
units.description: Compute cutter-contact (CC) points on analytical surfaces: planes, cylinders, cones, spheres, tori. For ball/flat/bull-nose/barrel cutters. CC point + tool axis vector + surface normal. Uses differential geometry: κ₁, κ₂ principal curvatures → scallop height = R - sqrt(R² - (stepover/2)²). Supports 3-axis and 5-axis (tilted tool axis).

units.title: StepoverOptimizationEngine — Curvature-adaptive stepover
units.description: Given target scallop height (Ra), surface curvature field, and cutter geometry: compute optimal stepover at each point. For ball: ae = 2*sqrt(2*R*scallop). For barrel (hyperMILL hm-104): ae = 2*sqrt(2*R_barrel*scallop). For flat: ae = stepover (constant). Adaptive: reduces stepover in high-curvature regions, increases in flat regions. Integrates with CFSF (constant-force) and AMEF (morphed engagement).

units.title: ToolAxisOptimizationEngine — 5-axis tool orientation for novel algorithms
units.description: Compute optimal tool axis orientation using: (1) gouge avoidance (minimum tilt), (2) stiffness maximization (align with cutting force), (3) surface normal following, (4) machine singularity avoidance. Uses Rodrigues' rotation formula, quaternion SLERP for smooth transitions. Integrates with PTDC (deflection compensation) and MACS (swarf cutting). Outputs (i,j,k) tool axis vectors per segment.
